title: Software Developer

evidence_notes.occupation_classification: MASCO 2512 is supported by the official MASCO 2020 classification.
evidence_notes.skills: Six selected skills are based on TalentCorp's Software Engineer profile, printed pages 106-107.
evidence_notes.ai_impact: Low AI impact is based on TalentCorp's Software Engineer classification, not an independently calculated prediction.
evidence_notes.skill_weights: Skill importance weights (1-4) are team-defined assumptions and are not official TalentCorp scores.
evidence_notes.job_market: DOSM Q2 2026 reports 19,899 online job offerings for Software Developers. This is a single observation, not proof of increasing demand.

weight_method: Team-defined illustrative skill importance weights (1-4). Not official TalentCorp or ESCO scores.
occupation_mapping_note: Malaysian Software Developers (MASCO 2512) mapped to TalentCorp ICT Software Engineer and ESCO software developer (ISCO 2512). These occupation records are not identical.
ai_impact_note: Low AI impact according to the TalentCorp ICT Software Engineer classification. This does not imply zero automation risk or guaranteed job security.

title: Accountants and Auditors

evidence_notes.occupation_classification: Accountants and Auditors are classified under MASCO 2411.
evidence_notes.skills: Six selected skills are drawn from TalentCorp's Global Business Services Finance and Accounting Function skills table, printed page 95. The table describes a job cluster, not every individual accounting role.
evidence_notes.ai_impact: TalentCorp identifies Cost Accountant, Internal Auditor and General Ledger Accountant among medium AI-impacted GBS roles. No single AI-impact level is assigned to the entire MASCO 2411 occupation.
evidence_notes.skill_weights: Skill importance weights from 1 to 4 are team-defined estimates, not official TalentCorp scores.
evidence_notes.job_market: DOSM reported 22,067 online job offerings for Accountants and Auditors in Q2 2026. This is a quarterly observation, not a forecast or a skill-demand measurement.
evidence_notes.sdgs: SDG 4, 8 and 16 mappings are project-defined interpretations, not official TalentCorp classifications.

weight_method: Team-defined illustrative skill importance weights (1-4). Not official TalentCorp scores.
occupation_mapping_note: MASCO 2411 Accountants and Auditors is broader than the Finance and Accounting Function roles covered by the TalentCorp GBS study.
ai_impact_note: AI impact varies by accounting role. Medium impact is documented for specified GBS specialisations, but should not be generalized to every Accountant and Auditor.
